desc: The Hybrid Breakdown Shotgun Case 3409 combines the protection of a rigid case with the style and portability of a canvas bag. The exterior is a rugged, weather-resistant 600 Denier ballistic nylon with a durable zipper closure and features two external pouches and an adjustable padded shoulder strap. The plush lined EPS interior will accommodate barrels up to 33.75" and offers the same protection as a hard case with a convenient lightweight construction.
